choice.basis: The chart title explicitly states 'Incidence of Condition A in US States,' which aligns with the task's directive to use the state prevalence dashboard. The color legend confirms that darker red corresponds to higher incidence (closer to 100), and lighter yellow corresponds to lower incidence (closer to 0). Among the three options, Florida (FL) is shaded in dark burgundy, indicating the highest incidence level; New Hampshire (NH) is pale yellow, indicating the lowest; and Delaware (DE) is orange, indicating an intermediate level. Therefore, Florida is the state with the highest plotted value and should be routed for highest-prevalence follow-up.
choice.option_label: Open Florida (FL) statistics view for priority follow-up
